'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Thomas E. Whaley LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whaley|Thomas E. Whaley]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Thomas Whaley|Thomas E. Whaley]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif|label=Quiet Mining Colony}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
